sources.title: IGP says police ready for crossfire if government allows it

quotes.text: Our responsibility is to apply the law and the Constitution wherever and whenever necessary. If a crossfire is necessary, and the government allows it, we will proceed accordingly,

sources.title: Police headquarters clarifies IGP remarks on crossfire

quotes.text: In illustrating the strict enforcement of the law, he referred to the term ‘crossfire’ in a literal sense. He did not use the word with the intention of denoting extrajudicial killings or imposing punishment outside the judicial framework.

sources.title: CPB headquarters in Dhaka attacked over alleged Awami League ties

quotes.text: The attackers are local BNP leaders, likely from the Paltan unit or allied organisations. They are attempting to brand us as Awami League.
Tension persists outside the CPB office, but there has been no assault or injury. Police are deployed at the scene,

sources.title: Bangladesh and Malaysia begin FTA talks in Dhaka

quotes.text: The two sides signed the terms of reference (ToR) at the opening session to set the framework and scope of the talks.
The first round of talks will continue until Oct 29.

sources.title: Bangladesh graduation status | UN LDC Portal

quotes.text: Bangladesh is scheduled to graduate on 24 November 2026

In a decision adopted on 21 July, ECOSOC took note of the CDP's conclusions and suggested courses of action and recommended that the G eneral Assembly take action on this matter before 24 November 2026.
